name: Webstudio

pricing.free_plan: Free Cloud plan: unlimited projects and pages, publishes to a wstd.io subdomain, project export included; custom domains and 100k page views need Pro ($15/month billed yearly)

tiers.name: Free
tiers.note: wstd.io subdomain, unlimited projects/pages, export included

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.note: custom domains, 100k page views/month, billed yearly

capabilities: Produces real HTML and CSS that can be exported
Open source, so the build can run anywhere
limits: No AI that builds a whole site from a prompt
No database or forms of its own
Free plan publishes to a wstd.io subdomain and includes project export (pricing page, checked 13.11.2026)
No prompt-based builder: Inception generates design variants and HTML/CSS for import, the site itself is built in the visual editor
summary: The only builder in this list whose output leaves as plain HTML and CSS — useful as the export baseline.
run_blocker: No AI prompt step: Inception generates design variants and HTML/CSS for import, the site is assembled in the visual editor — a same-brief run would measure the operator, not the tool. Practical check 13.11.2026: account via Google works, project created and published to btl-webstudio-check-qotb3.wstd.io, but that domain answers HTTP 403 with cf-mitigated: challenge to curl and to our headless Chrome, so the published page could not be verified; project export not tested.

custom_domain.detail: Custom domains need Pro ($15/month billed yearly); the free plan publishes to a wstd.io subdomain

no_ai.reason: Visual site builder without an AI prompt; designs are assembled by hand in the editor.
